description: This PHP class represents a model for user API keys within the Goteo project. It provides methods to retrieve, validate, and save API keys associated with users, interacting with a database via SQL queries.

classes.name: Apikey
classes.description: A model class managing API keys for users, including retrieval, validation, and persistence of API key records.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the API key for a specific user ID from the database.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that both the API key and user ID are set.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates the user's API key in the database.
